newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hattori appointed president of NatWest Securities.
newsitem.headline: Hattori appointed president of NatWest Securities.

text.p: Shichiro Hattori has been appointed president of NatWest Securities Japan Ltd, NatWest Markets said on Monday.
NatWest Securities is currently seeking to acquire memberships on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Osaka Securities Exchange. It had given up its membership on the TSE in 1993.
"It is necessary to strengthen further the leadership of the expanded securities business in Tokyo," NatWest Markets said in a statement.
Hattori is currently a director at NatWest Markets.
NatWest Markets is the corporate and investment banking arm of National Westminster Bank of Britain. NatWest Securities Japan is an affiliate of National Westminster Bank.
